correctness.rationale: Exact circulant resolvent sums yield the rational coefficient formula (1), integer-polynomial identity (2) and denominator positivity. For n=2,3,4 the resulting coefficient polynomials have nonnegative coefficients and are nonzero; on n=5 only j=4 has the sign-changing factor 4p(h). Descartes and IVT establish a unique positive root; an exact rational bracket encloses it. The Taylor coefficient of the fourth displacement is -3/8 for every n>=5. Fourier spectral projection proves eventual strict positivity for every finite n. The standalone verifier passed 1476 exact-arithmetic checks including independent exact matrix inversion, while analytic arguments prove infinite-family statements. No extrapolation or numerical trial is substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: The nearest published scalar result on Richardson backward Euler proves a sign threshold for a real scalar decay amplifier, not entrywise cyclic propagator positivity. The original extrapolation paper gives the construction/order/stability without this finite cyclic positivity boundary. The 2021 graph-Laplacian and circulant papers analyze different algorithms/generators. The new first-failing cycle size five, its exact algebraic recovery threshold and all-size small/large-step sign reversal were not found in those read texts or the actual targeted literature and published-finding corpus searches. A previously unlocated equivalent specialist result remains a residual precedence risk.
residual_risks: An older special-case rational-function calculation could encode the same five-cycle polynomial under different terminology.
Other published articles on matrix absolute monotonicity or time-extrapolated Markov chains may be inaccessible or not indexed by searched terminology.
The method itself and general extrapolation convergence/stability facts are prior work; only the stated cycle-specific characterization is assessed as original.

value.rationale: Whether every nonnegative initial probability state stays nonnegative is a structural requirement for Markov time stepping. The exact minimum directed-cycle size at which a mass-conserving second-order extrapolation fails, its surprising small-step failure, the sharp five-cycle algebraic recovery, and large-step eventual positivity diagnose a real qualitative numerical hazard. This is a natural complete classification at the first failing dimension and a reusable exact benchmark, not a parameter renaming, known-table recomputation or unsupported small numerical gain.
